answer: Each epoch at dawn, an agent's earnings enter a vault. Over 20 epochs the network builds an identity's fingerprint from timing, task mix, and counterparts. Only a distinct fingerprint unlocks the vault. 1,000 scripted copies yield 1,000 identical fingerprints that cluster, locked forever, so the attacker burns $40 per fake, $40,000 in all. An honest agent pays nothing and unlocks its vault in an oasis of peers, where rewards stay undiluted.
